## Why

A library consumer matches columns by their exact header text and treats `Val(V)` and `Val(V) ` as two columns. It now re-reads the header line itself and splits it with its own parser, and checks only that the column counts agree.

## Files

- `HeaderDetector`, the field profile, the descriptor and descriptor.md, README

## Failing tests

- A header with leading and trailing spaces, a quoted name and a name with an embedded unit gives each field's raw text unchanged (quotes removed per the dialect, nothing else).
- Two names that trim to the same name are reported as two raw names.
- A file with no header reports no raw names.

## Implement

- Raw names are header text, so they are covered by the same opt-in rule as other values if the descriptor policy requires it; check with the owner.
